description: Human-in-the-loop gates. The boat runs free on everything except money, deploy, payments, and public posts — those require an explicit human approval label before merge.

rules.why: Never merge a payment change without a thumb.
Public words are permanent. Human owns the voice.

notes: Checked by nexus.gates (requires_human_gate / unmet_human_gates). Enforced by the human-gate check in .github/workflows/nexus-human-gate.yml, which fails while a required label is missing and re-runs when labels change. It is a hard block only when main's ruleset requires that check.
